crossRefs.note: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
translations.bsb: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
translations.kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
translations.asv: But John would have hindered him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
